title: Glassential StationAPI
description: Adds various types of glass each with different unique mechanic
body:
Uses textures from the 1.12.2 version of [Glassential](https://modrinth.com/mod/glassential) by Lykrast.
---

Adds various types of glass each with different unique mechanic:
* Clear Glass - Normal glass but clear
* Dark Glass - Does not let light go thru it
* Ethereal Glass - Allows players to pass through it
* Reverse Ethereal Glass - Allow any entity but players to pass through it
* Ghostly Glass - Allows any entity to pass through it
* Luminous Glass - Emits light
* Redstone Glass - Emits redstone signal
